chunks: O my people, let not my dissent cause you to be struck by a calamity like that which struck the people of Noah, or the people of Hud, or the people of Saleh; and the people of Lot are not distant from you.
ai.seo_question: What warning does Prophet Hud give to his people in Surah Hud regarding their opposition to him?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the continuity of divine warning through successive prophets, emphasizing that communal disunity (shiqqaq) and rejection of truth invite the same fate as earlier nations. The mention of Noah, Hud, and Saleh serves as a cumulative precedent, while the reference to Lot underscores the proximity of their punishment to the current audience. This reinforces the Shia understanding of the 'Ahl al-Bayt' and Imams as the continuing bearers of this prophetic message against societal deviation.
